Subject: MAP Kickoff: Acme Retail private deployment — owners & initial timeline

Hi Lindsay / George —

Thanks again for prioritizing the private/VPC evaluation with us. Per our call yesterday, attaching a first-pass MAP and a rough topology sketch so we can line up owners and hit the target close window (pilot by end of July).

High-level asks for this kickoff:
- Confirm owners for network/VPN, IAM, and KMS (see suggested owners below).
- Confirm a preferred window for an initial network validation (we recommend a 2-hour session the week of June 7).
- Share any compliance constraints around key management or encryption in transit/storage.

Suggested owner roster (please adjust):
- Network/VPN: Acme SRE (George Patel) + Redwood infra (Marcus Lin)
- IAM/KMS: Acme Security (Lindsay West) + Redwood Security (Priya Natarajan)
- Deployment topology/staging: Acme Platform (George) + Redwood Solutions (Laura Bennett)

Attachments: MAP_Acme_Private_Eval.xlsx (MAP draft) and network_topology_v1.drawio (sketch).

Proposed near-term timeline:
- 5/28: Kickoff + owner roster confirmed
- 6/07–6/10: Network validation window (2 hours)
- 6/15: Access & KMS proof-of-ownership checks complete
- 7/15–7/31: Pilot run (controlled traffic)

If this looks good I’ll convert the attached MAP to a shared HubSpot record and schedule the network session.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
